newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Fibertek to buy Black Clawson unit.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Fibertek to buy Black Clawson unit.

text.p: Thermo Fibertek Inc said on Thursday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire the assets of The Black Clawson Co's stock-preparation business for approximately $110 million in cash and the assumption of certain liabilities.

Black Clawson, a privately held company, generated revenues of more than $100 million from the sale of stock-preparation machinery for the manufacture of brown paper for the fiscal year ended March 31, 1996, Thermo Fibertek said.
Black Clawson's stock-preparation business is based in Middletown, Ohio, Thermo Fibertek said.

The transaction is subject to several conditions, including due diligence, a definitive agreement, regulatory approvals, and approval by the boards of Thermo Fibertek, Thermo Electron Corp and Black Clawson.
Thermo Fibertek is a publicly traded subsidiary of Thermo Electron.
